headline: Real Madrid appoint Jose Mourinho as manager on three-year deal
summary: The Portuguese tactician returns to the Bernabeu to end a trophy drought and restore discipline after a chaotic domestic campaign.
details: Real Madrid have officially appointed Jose Mourinho as their new manager on a three-year contract. The 63-year-old Portuguese tactician will join the club on July 13, coinciding with the start of the preseason.

The move follows a humiliating end to the domestic season, where Barcelona clinched the league title with a 2-0 victory in El Clasico. It was the first time in 94 years that the Spanish league was decided by a match between the two rivals.

The club has struggled recently, failing to reach the Champions League quarter-finals in the last two seasons and going two years without a major trophy. This prompted president Florentino Perez to take decisive action.

Internal chaos further plagued the team, including a dressing room fight between captain Federico Valverde and Aurelien Tchouameni. Both players were fined 500,000 euros each after Valverde was hospitalized with a cut.

Mourinho previously managed Real Madrid from 2010-2014, winning the Copa del Rey and a record-breaking 100-point LaLiga title. However, his tenure was also marked by intense rivalry and tension with Barcelona.

President Perez believes Mourinho's ability to handle big egos and restore discipline is essential for the current squad. He will now lead a star-studded team featuring Kylian Mbappe, Vinicius Jr, and Jude Bellingham.
caption:
The 'Special One' is back! Jose Mourinho returns to Real Madrid to end a trophy drought and fix a fractured dressing room.

Real Madrid have officially appointed Jose Mourinho as their new manager on a three-year contract. The 63-year-old Portuguese tactician will join the club on July 13, coinciding with the start of the preseason.

The move follows a humiliating end to the domestic season, where Barcelona clinched the league title with a 2-0 victory in El Clasico. It was the first time in 94 years that the Spanish league was decided by a match between the two rivals.

The club has struggled recently, failing to reach the Champions League quarter-finals in the last two seasons and going two years without a major trophy. This prompted president Florentino Perez to take decisive action.

Internal chaos further plagued the team, including a dressing room fight between captain Federico Valverde and Aurelien Tchouameni. Both players were fined 500,000 euros each after Valverde was hospitalized with a cut.

Mourinho previously managed Real Madrid from 2010-2014, winning the Copa del Rey and a record-breaking 100-point LaLiga title. However, his tenure was also marked by intense rivalry and tension with Barcelona.

President Perez believes Mourinho's ability to handle big egos and restore discipline is essential for the current squad. He will now lead a star-studded team featuring Kylian Mbappe, Vinicius Jr, and Jude Bellingham.
